Formal/written register for "a man", typical of news reports (一名男子). In speech, use 男的 or 男人.

Physical/structural link (roads, cables, webpages). Contrast 联系, which is contacting a person or an abstract association between ideas.
An official post carrying formal duties (免去…职务 remove from post). Contrast 职位 (the job slot/title, more neutral) and 职责 (the duties themselves).

Also slang for 'positive energy/vibes' (正能量, motivational content) — not just physics energy.

Institutional/project budget money (research grants, org funding) — not personal spending money (费用/花销) or investment capital (资金).

As verb, takes the area of responsibility as object: 他主管财务 he's in charge of finance. As noun, a formal title (部门主管). Contrast everyday 负责.
Almost always in 到...为止: 到目前为止 so far/up to now · 报名到本周五为止 registration closes Friday. Rarely stands alone.
Ambiguous: after a number = 'N years ago' (十年前 ten years ago); standalone = 'before [Lunar] New Year.' A preceding number disambiguates.
Escaping/detaching from a binding or dangerous condition, not just 'leaving': 脱离危险 out of danger · 脱离现实 detached from reality. Contrast plain 离开.

For formal agreements between two+ parties (treaties, contracts) — not just signing your name (that's 签名/签字): 签订合同/协议.
More formal/institutional than 允许: often as noun/object — 得到许可 obtain permission, 许可证 permit/license (document).

A quantitative target or metric (quota, KPI, index): 销售指标 sales quota · 经济指标 economic indicator. Not a general 'sign' (迹象/标志).
The main/bulk component of something (学生是这次活动的主体 students make up most of the participants) — structural, not a leadership role (that's 主导).

Qualitative/essential transformation: 阳光转化成能量 sunlight transforms into energy. Contrast 转换, more mechanical/technical switching (格式转换).
Formal, esp. judicial/moral impartiality (法官办事很公正 the judge is impartial). Contrast 公平, the everyday word for fair treatment/opportunity.

Figurative cost/sacrifice, not a literal price tag (that's 价格): 付出代价 pay the price · 代价高昂 costly (in effort/consequence).
Adverbial before a verb = 'prioritize doing X': 优先处理 handle first. As noun: 优先权 right of priority.

The border zone/region itself, not just the boundary line — contrast 边界, which is the line/border itself.

Two senses: a research institute, or (esp. Taiwan Mandarin) grad school — 考研究所 apply to grad school (mainland usually says 考研/读研究生).
Near-synonym of 联系 but slightly more formal, implying ongoing liaison/networking: 保持联络 stay in touch, vs the more one-off 联系我 contact me.
Top corporate title, roughly CEO/president — distinct from 董事长 (board chairman) and 总经理 (general manager), though usage varies by company.
Abstract 'form/state' of matter or phenomena: 意识形态 ideology · 物质形态 state of matter. Contrast 形状, the concrete physical shape of an object.
Technical specs/capability of a device or material (手机性能 phone performance). Contrast 表现, how a person or team performs (behavior/results).
Common in set terms for mobility: 流动人口 migrant population · 流动摊贩 mobile vendor · 流动资金 liquid capital. Broader than literal liquid flow.
For abstract things vanishing — fears, misunderstandings, hazards: 消除误解/隐患. Contrast 排除, ruling out a possibility or clearing an obstruction.
Founding something new and original — a company, school of thought, brand. Contrast 成立 (formally established, more neutral) and 建立 (build, general).
Mechanical/technical switching: 格式转换 file format conversion · 转换角色 switch roles. Contrast 转化, the more essential/qualitative transformation.
More formal/academic than 比赛 (everyday 'game/match'): 数学竞赛 math competition. 比赛 also covers sports and casual games.
Need-based financial aid — scholarships, research funding, poor students. Contrast 赞助, commercial/promotional sponsorship (企业赞助活动).
Verb-obj (辞+职) — can't add another object; say 辞去经理职务 to name the position, not 辞职经理. 辞职信 = resignation letter.
For concrete rules/laws/discipline: 遵守法律/纪律. Contrast 遵循, used for more abstract principles or guidelines (遵循原则).
Narrower than 现代 (modern era generally) — 当代 = specifically 'of our current times': 当代艺术/文学 contemporary art/literature.
The organizing entity behind an event: 主办方/主办单位 the host organization. Contrast 举办, the verb for simply 'holding' an event (举办比赛).
More rigorous/technical than 检查 (everyday check): 检验产品质量. Also figurative: 经得起时间的检验 stand the test of time.

A top-down directive from someone in authority (boss, doctor, official). Contrast 指导, collaborative guidance/mentoring, not an order.
A recurring cycle with a fixed length: 洗涤周期 wash cycle · 生命周期 lifecycle. Contrast 时期 (an era/phase) and 期间 (during a span of time).
Institutional/bulk procurement — a company's purchasing dept (采购员 purchasing agent). Contrast everyday 买/购买 for personal shopping.

(formal/technical) Common in UI/tech ('back' button: 返回上一页) and official reports — everyday 'come/go back' is 回来/回去.
The underlying scientific/technical mechanism (工作原理 how something works). Contrast 道理, everyday reasoning, and 理论, a broader theory.
Inherent technical property, esp. of materials/substances (防水特性 waterproof property). Contrast 特点, the general word for a notable feature.
(written) Slightly more formal than 以前, often explicitly contrasted with 现在: 以往...现在... = 'used to...but now...'.

Common in 在...(的)前提下 = 'on the premise/condition that...': 在安全的前提下. Also X是Y的前提 = X is a precondition for Y.

Mainly spatial/physical nearness: 靠近窗户 near the window. Contrast 接近, which also works abstractly (接近成功 close to success).

Colloquial equivalent of 一生 (a lifetime): 他一辈子都住在这里. 一生 is the more written/formal counterpart.
Institutional/collective — 'the higher-ups' or governing body (问上级的意见). Contrast 上司, one's specific direct boss (a personal relationship).
A step/link within a sequential process (检查是生产过程中的环节 inspection is a step in production) — implies interconnected stages, not just any 部分.
(literary) Nostalgic/poetic register for the passage of time: 美好时光 fond memories/good times. Neutral 'time' is 时间.
Taking on a role/identity — literal acting (扮演小妖精 play a sprite) or figurative (扮演重要角色 play an important role in a situation).
Weightier than 希望 — implies expectations placed ON someone, often by others: 对孩子抱有很高的期望 have high hopes for one's child (pressure-laden).

Narrative plot (小说情节), or in legal contexts, the specific circumstances of a case (犯罪情节). Not general 'situation' (that's 情况).
Institutional performance review (对员工进行考核 evaluate employees) — not an academic exam (that's 考试).
To rule out a possibility or physically clear an obstruction: 排除...的可能性, 排除故障 troubleshoot. Contrast 消除, for making abstract problems disappear.

Artistic technique (绘画手法), or negatively, a cunning trick/scheme (欺骗手法 deceptive tactic) — context decides which. More skill-flavored than neutral 方法.

Rallying people to actually take action: 号召大家参与 call on everyone to join in. Contrast 呼吁, a public appeal for something more abstract (policy change).
Economic/commercial circulation specifically — money, goods: 纸币流通 currency circulation. Contrast 流动, the broader word for general flow/mobility.

The underlying WHY behind an action, often scrutinized: 犯罪动机 criminal motive. Contrast 动力, the positive driving force/energy to do something.
A formal job title (总裁助理 executive assistant, 助理教授 assistant professor). Contrast 助手, the general word for 'helper' in any context.

Slows/blocks progress passively, like an obstacle: 积雪阻碍交通. Contrast 阻止, which actively stops something from happening at all.
A supporting/secondary role: 辅助工具 auxiliary tool · 辅助设备 supporting equipment. More formal/technical than everyday 帮助 (help).

Technical 'generate' — computing, chemistry, biology: 自动生成报告 auto-generate a report. Contrast 产生, the broader word for abstract effects arising.

Perception, not action — how you view/judge something: 如何看待这个问题 how do you see this issue. Contrast 对待, how you actually treat someone.

Universal/philosophical truth (地球绕太阳转是真理). Contrast 真相, the concealed facts of a specific event/case (真相大白).

Stronger than 吃惊 (surprised) — a strong shock reaction, often to alarming news: 这个消息让大家震惊.

Mainly 'meteorology/weather' (气象部门 weather bureau), but also figurative 'atmosphere/vibe': 新气象 a fresh new look/start.
Obeying orders/rules/authority specifically: 服从命令, 服从安排. More formal/institutional than general compliance.
Restoring to original condition — software (修复bug), relationships (修复关系), historical relics (修复古迹). Broader/more formal than 修理 (mechanical repair).

Crime/public-order sense of 'security,' not personal safety (安全) or procedure (秩序). Collocates: 维持治安, 治安好/差。

Term for Mandarin used by overseas Chinese communities (Singapore, Malaysia). Contrast 汉语/中文 (used in China) and 普通话 (Standard Mandarin specifically).
Polysemous beyond 'exercise/sports': also a political/social campaign or movement (政治运动, 五四运动 the May Fourth Movement).
Pattern: 在+place+长大 (grow up in a place): 在北京长大. Resultative — splits: 长不大 (never grows up; fig. 'immature').
Informal/spoken 'husband' — contrast 丈夫, the neutral, more formal term used in writing or introductions.
Often figurative: a shift in stance/attitude/policy, not just physical turning: 态度转向, 政策转向 policy shift.
Justification for an action/decision (subjective) — contrast 原因 yuányīn, the objective cause of an event.
Often in 有道理 (that makes sense) or 讲道理 (be reasonable). Contrast 理由, a specific justification for one's own action.
Resultative, common in potential form: 做得到/做不到 (can/can't manage it). Implies achieving a standard, not just 'doing'.
Resultative (见+到) — mostly for meeting/encountering PEOPLE (见到老师), whereas 看到 kàndào is for seeing things/events generally.
Emphasizes the abruptness of a CHANGE: 天气一下子冷了 (weather suddenly turned cold). Contrast 突然, which marks any unexpected event more broadly.
Collocation: 提出观点 (put forward a view), 持…观点 (hold the view that…). Contrast 意见 yìjiàn, which leans toward personal opinion or complaint.
Fuller/more common form is 也就是说 — both mean 'in other words', used to restate or clarify the previous statement.
Collocates with 采取/展开 (take/launch): 采取行动, 展开行动 — echoes the 采取+措施/行动 pattern.
Often a standalone reaction: 太过分了！(that's too much/going too far!) — like 糟糕, functions as an exclamation, not just a modifier.
Homophone trap: 权力 quánlì = 'power/authority' (公司给了他权力); 权利 quánlì = 'rights' (法律权利) — same pronunciation, different characters/meaning.
Polysemous: after a number = 'approximately' (三点左右); as a verb = 'to control/influence' (你不要左右我的决定).
Abstract resultative uses beyond literal descent: 安静下来 (calm down), 记录下来 (write down), 坚持下来 (make it through, persist).
